locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via
goal: Refutation track (#143): give the irrelevant-respect objection to the strong per se premise its strongest sourced formulation, modeled as a complete rival account of motion and the regress (owner principle: no win by subtraction), and assess it against the strong reading.
reason: The objection says a mover can be moved only in respects irrelevant to its moving, so the strong premise (every distinct moved mover is a per se link) is false. AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-IRRELEVANT-RESPECT-OBJECTION-SCOPE shows that the objection's situation is compatible with the strong premises; the open work is the objection's attack on the strong premise itself, which needs a sourced defense (e.g. ST I q.105 a.5) or a reply.
